name: USDFC
oneLiner: USDFC is Secured Finance’s FIL-backed dollar on Filecoin, minted through collateralized Troves and redeemable on-chain for oracle-valued FIL.
collateral: Native FIL held in Filecoin ActivePool and DefaultPool contracts; 110% minimum Trove collateralization and 150% system Recovery Mode threshold.
pegMechanism: Any holder can redeem USDFC for $1 of oracle-valued FIL less 0.5% plus the dynamic Base Rate when system collateralization is at least 110%; permissionless liquidation uses the Stability Pool and redistributes uncovered debt and collateral.
